title: ononis hircina var. spinosiformis
intro: Ononis hircina var. spinosiformis, commonly known as a spiny restharrow, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Ononis hircina var. spinosiformis include its ability to act as an analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for pain and fever relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may provide additional health benefits.
